$comment: AL-52 (ADD v3.3 §1.15): Tailwind CSS is the sole styling system for every MageRide web
surface. MUI, Bootstrap, styled-components, Emotion and other runtime CSS-in-JS are
excluded — CSS is compiled at build time by PostCSS inside `npm run build`.
This file is the ONE place inside portals/ where those package names are spelled. The
C103 Definition of Done asks that a grep for them across portals/ come back empty; the
enforcement list is the single expected hit, and `portals/scripts/check-al52.mjs` is the
executable form of that grep — it skips this file and fails on every other occurrence.
Headless primitives styled with Tailwind (Radix UI, Headless UI) are permitted and are
deliberately absent from this list; pre-styled component kits are not.
